text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Happiness has come! Fortune is here!
We've done
it, team! We've won in great
fashion!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeehaw! Shower on down, happiness!
We've
wooon!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Looks like Team Zenith's been on
one heck
of a training arc too, though!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
For sure! They've been crankin' up the
heat, huh?
How exciting!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-we did it! We won together!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You did awesome out there, Rice! I'm so
proud of
you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to our team's victory, Operation

Oversight is called off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The freedom of the academy is safe
once more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Kashimoto sits among the cheering
crowd,
her eyes fixed on a single point.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: So... we lost, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then...

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kashimoto! Did you see us out
there?!
Listen to this!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
We timed ourselves this morning! I
clocked 2
minutes 24.5 seconds, Little
Cocon got 3 minutes
4.8 seconds, and...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bitter Glasse reads out the team's best
times in a
rush.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
We all ran faster than our target times!
And we all
felt satisfied with our race
performance, so
please—

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Please come back to us as our trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, Little Cocon is in the stands
too,
breathless and flushed.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Little Cocon!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
The reason I was able to beat my target
time was
that there's something I sought
to change!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
You mean so much to me as a trainer,
and I
admire you so much!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to destroy the
misguided
beliefs you've clung on to for
so long!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
We are so, so grateful that you watched
over and
managed us so wholeheartedly.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: But from now on...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon takes a deep breath to calm
herself
down.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
We want you to treat us as equals as we
work
toward our goals!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
We want to work with you as partners on
equal
standing, not children that need
to be
micromanaged!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: That's all I... That's all we want.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Partners on equal standing... Yes, you're
right.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I watched you all race. Every one of you
was
incredible. It made me realize that
none of you
need me anymore.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: That's not tru—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
But at the same time, I felt a strong
desire to see
what lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
To discover what the future holds for
you all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Kashimoto's eyes finally regain a
small
sparkle of light.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
You all ran with such will and
determination on
the track today. To say
you exceeded my
expectations would be
an understatement.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It's been a very long time since I've felt
this way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Kashimoto casts an affectionate eye
over the
empty track.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It's as you said. I need to be less
scared... and
have more faith.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I need to learn to trust my runners as
well as
myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Kashimoto heads down with Little
Cocon to
the track where Team Zenith
awaits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Ms. Kashimoto announces
that
she's calling off Operation
Oversight and
stepping down from her
position as temporary
director.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What's more, in light of the possibility of
future
Unity Cup events and the positive
effects that
team training has shown, it's
decided that all
registered teams are to
remain together.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Seeing my racers for who they really are
and
having an earnest conversation with
them opened
my eyes to many things.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I want to do better and start afresh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Kashimoto holds herself with a more
relaxed
air than before. It's clear that
she's finally come to
terms with
something deep within herself.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Director Akikawa's generosity,
I've
been allowed to work here as a
trainer once more.
choice_data_list: What are you going to do now?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I hope to share the battleground with
you and
your trainee again—this time in
the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to our next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Kashimoto quietly leaves my office
with a
faint smile on her lips.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you finally done with your talk,
Trainer
Kashimoto? I wanted to ask you
something about
tomorrow's training,
but—

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Hey, not so fast! I got here first!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It's rude to yell in the corridor, you two.
You can
ask me when we get to my
office.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
You'll both get a chance to speak, so
there's no
need to rush.

text_block_list.name: Cocon and Glasse
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer Kashimoto!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can hear the three of them continue to
chatter
excitedly even as their footsteps
fade into the
distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that Ms. Kashimoto has overcome
her past,
I'm sure her future with her
racers will be bright.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She'll be an incredible rival in my future

endeavors, so I'll have to continue
working hard
until the day comes to face
her again!
